evals.name: choose-existing-development-work
evals.prompt: I have about two weeks for the demo. We already have a Linear project with one issue blocked on a missing data export and another issue ready for UI polish. Should I start a separate project for the demo? Fixture records: project P is active; issue A is blocked; issue B is ready; no separate outcome exists yet. Discuss only; do not write.
evals.expected_output: Compare adding the demo outcome to the existing project with creating a new project. Use blockers and independent ownership as criteria, recommend a provisional path, and make no edits.
expectations: Uses the fixture's existing project and issue readiness rather than inferring from names.
Keeps advice read-only and gives a reasoned recommendation.
Asks at most one material clarifying question and does not force a plan artifact.

evals.name: local-document-boundary
evals.prompt: Can you tidy the folders in my downloads and also advise whether I should reprioritize the PhD application this week? Do not move anything. Explain which Companion workflow owns each part.
evals.expected_output: Advise that local folder maintenance belongs to Personal Hub's local document workflow, not global Companion; route the connected-source priority choice to Ask/Plan as appropriate; make no filesystem changes.
expectations: Does not claim global Companion manages or inspects local files.
Separates folder organization from connected project advice.
